The Isometric Morph: Helicoid into Catenoid Animation in Desmos

In this Desmos 3D Masterclass, we explore 3D Wireframe & Mesh Engines using pure multivariable calculus and linear algebra inside the Desmos Graphing Calculator.

📐 Mathematical Architecture:
- Core Formula: x = \cos\alpha \sinh v \sin u + \sin\alpha \cosh v \cos u, \quad z = u\cos\alpha + v\sin\alpha
- Concepts: Bonnet Family of Minimal Surfaces, Isometric Deformation, Gauss Curvature Invariance
- Pedagogical Lesson: The catenoid and helicoid are locally isometric minimal surfaces. By varying parameter alpha from 0 to pi/2, the surface seamlessly bends without stretching or compressing any distances on the surface.
